messages:
elaine: Quick sync — opened a PR to update the Regions & Data Residency page with HK and Seoul availability + Private deployment caveats. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/942
sam: nice, can you also add a short note about export controls and customer-managed KMS? legal asked for both to be explicit.
matt: I can add a Python SDK snippet showing region selection and KMS key usage. will push in a follow-up commit.
luis: FYI we need to be careful with the wording for 'data residency' — legal prefers 'data processing region' and a link to the compliance page. pinging @nisha for wording sign-off.
nisha: saw this, will review wording tomorrow morning. prefer: 'Customer data is processed and stored in the selected region unless otherwise specified.' That avoids implying absolute residency guarantees.
elaine: thanks — updated the PR description with that phrasing. also fixed the region table header to "Supported regions (hosted/dedicated/private)" per Sam's earlier ask.
sam: can we add a small migration note for Dedicated customers who want to move from us-east to eu-west? steps + downtime expectations. even a short checklist is fine.
matt: added a migration checklist section and an example CLI command to start a region migration:
```bash
# start migration for customer 12345
redwoodctl migrate --customer 12345 --from us-east-1 --to eu-west-1 --dry-run
```
elaine: perfect. I left a comment on the PR about linking the console screenshot for 'region selector' — small UX change.
luis: also flagged that Private (on-prem) availability varies by package; suggest adding a footnote and linking the Private deployment matrix.
docs-bot: PR #942 — preview deployed at https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/regions/region-availability — snapshot generated.
elaine: QA request: can someone skim the staging page for any wording that implies 'data never leaves the region'? legal will block that.
nisha: I'll review the staging page and comment inline. if phrasing is okay I'll +1 the PR.
matt: pushed SDK snippet commit: shows region and kms_key params for python and ts, plus small code comment about fallbacks.
elaine: tiny follow-up: change 'HK' to 'Hong Kong (asia-east2)' in the table for clarity.
sam: :thumbsup: once legal approves, let's merge and add a short changelog entry for the docs weekly email.
docs-bot: Merge readiness check: conflicts? none. unresolved comments? 2 (both addressed). CI: docs build ✅.
elaine: thanks all — I'll wait for Nisha then merge. Dropping a note in the weekly docs sync to remind PMs about the migration checklist. :memo:
